**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

Kubient's Section 9(b) warranty package meets and in places exceeds the preferred position:

- **Scope:** Service performs "in all material respects to industry standards" (9(b)(ii)); services "free from errors that materially affect their utility" (9(b)(vi)); no viruses/malicious code (9(b)(iv)); compliance with applicable Laws throughout the Term (9(b)(ix)); plus IP non-infringement and ownership warranties.
- **Duration:** framed as continuing representations, warranties and covenants for the full Term — better than the preferred 12-month/90-day windows.
- **Disclaimer does not swallow it:** Section 13 opens "Except as expressly set forth herein" and expressly excepts "the representations and warranties set forth in this Agreement," so the "as is" language is confined to implied warranties. Not walk-away territory.

Noted but not flagged: there is no express repair/replace/refund remedy sentence. Importing one would risk converting our open general-law remedies (plus the 30-day cure/termination right in paragraph 4(b) and the warranty-breach indemnity in 11(a)(iv)) into a narrower vendor-elected exclusive remedy, so pressing the model language here would work against us.
